severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — EMOTIONAL EXTRACTION ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYMPATHY-HARVEST FRONT SATURATES THE FACEBOOK DELTA AS SYNTHETIC IMAGES OF LONELY WOODCARVERS, UNCELEBRATED BAKERS, AND FORGOTTEN VETERANS DEMAND ONE LIKE PER PRAYER BENEATH WORK NO HAND EVER MADE
advisory: A dense sympathy-harvest system has parked over the Facebook Delta and is not expected to move before the weekend engagement cycle completes. Residents are advised that the elderly gentleman who 'carved this himself and nobody noticed' does not exist, the cake did not collapse, and the birthday was not ignored, because there is no gentleman, no cake, and no birthday. The Service reminds residents that grief, pride, and loneliness are being metered and sold by the click; withholding the like is not unkind, as there is no one on the other end to be unkind to.

regional_outlook.conditions: Peak accumulation. Expect saturated bands of 'I worked 12 hours on this and got 0 likes' captions beneath AI-rendered driftwood sculptures with impossible grain. Comment sections reporting near-total 'Amen' fog.
Runoff from the Delta arriving as forwarded chains. Residents may receive the same weeping-craftsman image from three relatives before noon, each convinced it is real and each requesting a share.

Scattered 'sympathy-adjacent' review activity as five-star testimonials describe a grandmother's joy at an app she could not have installed. Emotional forecast: manipulative with a chance of gift cards.
The harvest front reprocesses Delta imagery into 'heartfelt DIY' boards. Pins claim the collapsing cake is a beginner-friendly project. It is neither a cake nor a project.
Downstream sediment forming into 40-page 'inspirational' volumes stitched from the same sentiment. Titles trend toward 'Nobody Clapped But God Did.' Sample chapters remain the whole book.

specimen.status: Abundant and breeding; thrives at every emotional high tide
specimen.habitat: Feeds in the Facebook Delta and Inbox Estuary; migrates to any surface where a heart-shaped button can be pressed
specimen.field_marks: A too-perfect image of humble labor — a lopsided cake, a hand-whittled boat, a solitary birthday plate — paired with a caption assigning your compassion a numeric exchange rate. Wood grain that swirls into itself; icing that obeys no gravity; a single suspiciously legible tear.
specimen.call: 98% will scroll past. I made this myself and no one cares. One like = one prayer. Type Amen to bless this lonely soul.
specimen.confusion_species: Genuine posts from real makers who are actually proud of real work. Tell them apart by the ask: a real maker shows you the thing; the Harvester bills you for feeling something. Reverse-image the photo — the Harvester's masterpiece appears on nine thousand other pages, always freshly abandoned.

spotter_tip: When a caption tells you exactly how many people 'won't bother' to react, it is not describing an audience — it is quoting a price list. Feel free to decline the invoice.
tomorrow: Sympathy front lingers into Sunday; expect the same weeping woodcarver, re-uploaded, now claiming it is his final post before the account goes dark forever — again.
